e.summary: **HL7 Da Vinci（付款方侧实施指南族）**（`HL7/davinci-pas` 等）**是一套**把**健康险**付款方（**payer）**与**医疗服务方**之间的**交换**写成**机器可读**实施指南的**标准族****——**⭐ 主条自述逐字为**「**Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) Implementation Guide**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 该族**在 **`org:HL7`** 下**共 **22 个仓库****；**⭐ 主条 **`davinci-pas` **★10**、**fork **13**、**体量 **8,080 KB**、**创建 **2019-03-03T09:34:12Z****、**⚠️ 最后推送 **2026-08-28T19:30:55Z****（**⭐ 窗口之外**）**、**许可逐字 **`NOASSERTION`****、**默认分支 **`master`****；**⭐ 同族**另含 **`davinci-epdx`（**★9、**888,881 KB、**Payer Data Exchange）、**`davinci-dtr`（**★8、**180,657 KB、**Apache-2.0、**文档模板与规则）、**`davinci-deqm`（**★8、**49,958 KB、**质量度量数据交换）、**`davinci-pdex-plan-net`（**★6、**33,545 KB）**、**`davinci-pdex-formulary`（**★4）**与 **`davinci-pct`（**★2、**患者成本透明）****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**按最薄类目定向补**」**，**并**走**方案 B（**把**标准做成**可执行形态）**——**⭐ 该族**填补的是**「**健康险**付款方**互操作标准**」这一缺口**，**而**本站**此前**只有**厂商**与**监管**侧**的**条文**与**数据，**没有**付款方**侧的**交换**规范**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **事前授权**（**PAS）**是**「**谁先**批准、**再**治疗**」**这条**流程**的**标准**形态**——**⭐ 即**它**定义**医疗方**与**付款方**之间**为**「**要不要**批**」**交换**什么**字段**；**② **PDex 与 **Plan Net** 覆盖**「**付款方**掌握**什么**、**网络**里**有**谁**」**——**⭐ 即**承保**与**理赔**两侧**的**对外**数据**；**③ **DTR 与 **DEQM** 把**「**规则**」**与**「**质量度量**」**也**做成**可**机器执行的**部分**；**④ ⚠️ **窗口**与**可读性**两处**限制**：**该族**最近推送 **2026-08-28**（**窗口之外**）**、**主条 **README** 只有 **77 字节****（**⭐ 全部信息**在**其**实施指南**站点**与**仓库**生成物里**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未构建、**未验证**其**任何**指南**。

e.summary_en: This is a family of machine-readable implementation guides describing the exchanges between health insurance payers and providers, whose primary repository describes itself in writing as a prior authorisation support implementation guide. **Measured this round**: the family numbers twenty-two repositories under the standards organisation; the primary repository has ten stars and thirteen forks, measures about eight megabytes, was created in March 2019, and was last pushed on the twenty-eighth of August, outside the window, under an unclassified licence and a master branch; the family also includes payer data exchange at nine stars and about eight hundred ninety megabytes, documentation templates and rules at eight stars under a permissive licence, quality measure data exchange, a plan network registry, a drug formulary, and patient cost transparency. **This entry belongs to the round theme of targeted gap filling and follows the plan of making standards executable, because the family fills the gap for health insurance payer-side interoperability standards, whereas the site previously held only vendor and regulatory texts and data rather than payer-side exchange specifications.** **Four things are worth reading: prior authorisation support is the standard form of the approve-before-treat workflow, defining which fields providers and payers exchange to decide whether something will be covered; the payer data exchange and plan network guides cover what a payer holds and who is in its network, that is, the outward-facing data on both the underwriting and claims sides; the documentation templates and quality measure guides turn rules and quality measurement into machine-executable parts of the same family; and two limits must be recorded, namely that the family last received a push in August outside the window and that the primary repository description runs to only seventy-seven bytes, with the substance living in the published guide sites and generated repository content.** **Nothing was built and no guide was validated this round.**
e.body:
**HL7 Da Vinci（付款方侧实施指南族）**（`HL7/davinci-pas` 等）**是一套**把**健康险**付款方（**payer）**与**医疗服务方**之间的**交换**写成**机器可读**实施指南的**标准族****——**⭐ 主条 **`davinci-pas`** 自述逐字为**「**Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) Implementation Guide**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**按最薄类目定向补**」**，**并**走**方案 B（**把**标准做成**可执行形态）**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-12 GitHub 接口与项目实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 事前授权（**PAS）**是**「**先**批**后**治**」**这条**流程的**标准**形态****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**主条**逐字**描述**为**「**IG to use FHIR to support the exchange of information (between the provider and the payer) nece**」**（**⭐ 该描述**在**接口返回处即为**截断**，**⭐ 本词条**如实标注**，**并**不**补全**）；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一点**对 RIAA **最实用**：**⭐ 即**事前授权**是**健康险**里**最**消耗**行政成本**的**环节**之一**，**而**「**要**交换**哪些**字段**」**一旦**被**写成**实施指南**，**就**可以**被**系统**实现**、**也**可以**被**评测**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**你**做**健康险**流程**或**理赔**自动化**，**应**先**读**这类**指南**而**不**是**先**读**厂商**文档**。

**⭐⭐ ② 同族的**其余**指南**覆盖**承保**与**理赔**两侧**的**对外**数据****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**同族**逐字**含 **`davinci-epdx`（**★9、**体量 **888,881 KB**、**最后推送 **2026-08-25**，**逐字**「**FHIR IG Payer Data Exchange (PDex)**」**）**、**`davinci-pdex-plan-net`（**★6、**33,545 KB、**2026-08-24**，**逐字**为**提供者、**组织与**地点的**注册**）**、**`davinci-pdex-formulary`（**★4、**21,074 KB、**2026-08-17**，**药品**目录）**与 **`davinci-pct`（**★2、**19,550 KB、**2026-07-08**，**患者**成本**透明）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**：**⭐ 即**这**四条**对应**「**付款方**手里**有什么**、**网络**里**有**谁**、**报**什么**药**、**患者**要**付**多少**」**——**⭐ 而**这些**正是**保险**与**医疗**双方**争议**最多**的**信息**面**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 规则与**质量度量**也**被**纳入**同一族****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**同族**逐字**含 **`davinci-dtr`（**★8、**180,657 KB、**Apache-2.0、**最后推送 **2026-08-21**，**逐字**「**Da Vinci Documentation Templates and Rules Implementation Guide**」**）**与 **`davinci-deqm`（**★8、**49,958 KB、**2026-08-24**，**逐字**「**Data Exchange for Quality Measures**」**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一组**说明**「**标准**可执行」**不只是**「**交换**数据**」**，**还**包括**「**交**规则**」**与**「**交**度量**」**——**⭐ 而**这**两件事**在**保险**里**分别**对应**核保**规则**与**质量**指标**。

**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 两处**限制**必须**同时**记下**：**窗口**与**可读性****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**① **该族**最近推送**为 **2026-08-28T19:30:55Z**（**主条**），**其余**多为 **2026-07-08 至 **2026-08-25****——**⭐ 即**整族**都**在**解冻窗口（**pushed **> 2026-09-05）**之外****；**⭐ 本词条**因此**按**既有**纪律**给出**具名**缺口**：「**健康险**付款方侧**的**互操作**实施指南**族**」**（**⭐ 本站**此前**未覆盖**，**而**该族**是**付款方**侧**最**完整的**公开**标准**族）**；**⭐ ② **主条 **README** 逐字**只有 **77 字节**／**1 行****，**⭐ 且**其**实施指南**站点**（**`hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-pas/`）**本次**实测**返回 **200**、**仅 **795 字节****——**⭐ 即**内容**来自**生成物**与**版本页**，**而**不**在**仓库**自述**里**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 对**不**想**先**读**一大套**实施指南**的人**，**本条**的价值**是**「**先**知道**这**一族**存在**、**各自**管**什么**」**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 同组织主干**在**窗口内**仍**活跃（**对照**记录）**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**`HL7/fhir`（**★745、**799,758 KB、**最后推送 **2026-09-12**，**逐字**「**Official source for the HL7 FHIR Specification**」**）**、**`HL7/fhir-cqm`（**★2、**18,640 KB、**2026-09-12**）**、**`HL7/fhir-us-ndh`（**★8、**6,659 KB、**2026-09-11**）**、**`HL7/fhir-consent-management`（**★3、**1,338 KB、**2026-09-11**）**与 **`HL7/data-access-policies`（**★4、**221 KB、**2026-09-11**）**；**⭐ 该组织**本次**共 **15 个仓库，**窗口内 **15 个****；**⭐ 本词条**由此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**标准**组织**还**在**动**」**与**「**付款方**那一支**最近**没动**」**可以**同时**成立**——**⭐ 故**判断**标准**生态**是否**活跃**，**要**分**子族**看**，**而**不**是**看**组织**整体**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[acord]] 覆盖**财产险**数据**标准**入口**、**[[cms-beneficiary-fhir]] 覆盖**美国**医保**受益人 **FHIR** 数据**、**[[badx12]] 覆盖**医保**理赔**报文（**X12）**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**付款方**与**医疗方**之间的**交换**规范**族**」这一**形态**（**⭐ 与 **X12 报文**属**同一**业务**面**、**但**属**不同**技术**世代）**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **先**分清**「**谁**批准**」与**「**谁**付钱**」**两类**交换**；**② **网络**与**药品**目录**是**对外**数据**的**组成部分**；**③ **规则**与**度量**也**可以**标准化**；**④ **组织**活跃**要**按**子族**判断**；**⑤ **README 短**不**等于**项目**小**（**内容**可能**在**生成物**里）**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有构建、**没有验证**其**任何**实施指南**（**未**用 **FHIR 校验器**跑过**任何**示例、**未**打开**任何**版本页**）**，**故**不主张**其**指南**的**正确性**或**可用性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**、**检索**结果的**描述字段**与**主条 **README**（**77 字节**）**，**未读**其**实施指南**正文**、**未读**其**生成物**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**该族**各指南**的**版本**状态**（**draft／**trial-use／**normative）**与**适用**辖区**（**⭐ 从**命名**看**主要**面向**美国**）。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**主条**语言**字段**为何**逐字**为 **`GLSL`**（**⭐ 本词条**如实**记录**这**一**异常**，**并**不**据此**推断**其**内容**构成**）。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**许可**状态**（**接口 **`NOASSERTION`**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-12 所见**；**⚠️ 该族**是**互操作**标准**材料**，**不是**承保**决定**，**也**不是**合规意见**。
e.body_hk:
**HL7 Da Vinci（付款方側實施指南族）**（`HL7/davinci-pas` 等）**是一套**把**健康險付款方**與**醫療服務方**之間的**交換**寫成**機器可讀**實施指南的**標準族****——**⭐ 主條 `davinci-pas` 自述逐字為**「**Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) Implementation Guide**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**按最薄類目定向補**」**，**並走**方案 B（**把標準做成可執行形態）**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-12 GitHub 介面與項目實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 事前授權（PAS）是「**先批後治**」流程的標準形態****——**主條描述逐字為**「**IG to use FHIR to support the exchange of information (between the provider and the payer) nece**」**（**⭐ 該描述在介面返回處即為截斷，本條如實標註而不補全**）；**⭐ 即**「**要交換哪些欄位**」**一旦寫成實施指南**，**就**可被系統實現、**也可被評測**。

**⭐⭐ ② 同族其餘指南覆蓋承保與理賠兩側的對外數據****——**逐字含** `davinci-epdx`（**★9、**888,881 KB、**2026-08-25**）、**`davinci-pdex-plan-net`（**★6、**33,545 KB、**2026-08-24**）、**`davinci-pdex-formulary`（**★4、**21,074 KB**）與 `davinci-pct`（**★2、**19,550 KB、**患者成本透明）**；**⭐ 即**付款方手裡有什麼、**網絡裡有誰、**報什麼藥、**患者付多少**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 規則與質量度量也被納入同一族****——**逐字含** `davinci-dtr`（**★8、**180,657 KB、**Apache-2.0、**2026-08-21**）與 `davinci-deqm`（**★8、**49,958 KB、**2026-08-24**）**。

**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 兩處限制****——**① **整族最近推送為 2026-07-08 至 2026-08-28****，**⭐ 即**都在解凍窗口之外**，**故本條按紀律給出**具名缺口**：「**健康險付款方側的互操作實施指南族**」；**② **主條 README 逐字只有 77 位元組／1 行****，**而**其**實施指南**站點本次實測**返回 200**、**僅 795 位元組****——**⭐ 即**內容在生成物與版本頁裡**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 同組織主幹在窗口內仍活躍****——**`HL7/fhir`（**★745、**799,758 KB、**2026-09-12**）、**`fhir-cqm`（**★2、**2026-09-12**）、**`fhir-us-ndh`（**★8、**2026-09-11**）、**`fhir-consent-management`（**★3、**2026-09-11**）、**`data-access-policies`（**★4、**2026-09-11**）**；**該組織 15 個倉庫、**窗口內 15 個****；**⭐ 即**判斷標準生態活躍度要分子族看**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[acord]]、[[cms-beneficiary-fhir]]、[[badx12]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**付款方與醫療方之間的交換規範族**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **分清誰批准與誰付錢兩類交換**；**② **網絡與藥品目錄是對外數據之一**；**③ **規則與度量也可標準化**；**④ **組織活躍度按子族判斷**；**⑤ **README 短不等於項目小**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有構建、**沒有驗證**其任何實施指南**，**不主張**其正確性或可用性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料、**檢索描述欄位與主條 README（**77 位元組**）**，**未讀**其實施指南正文與生成物**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**各指南版本狀態與適用轄區**（**命名上看主要面向美國**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**主條語言欄位為何逐字為 `GLSL`**（**如實記錄異常，**不據此推斷內容構成**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其許可狀態**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-12 所見**；**⚠️ 該族是互操作標準材料**，**不是**承保決定**，**也**不是**合規意見**。
e.body_en:
This is a family of machine-readable implementation guides describing the exchanges between health insurance payers and providers, whose primary repository describes itself as a prior authorisation support implementation guide. **This entry belongs to the round theme of targeted gap filling, and it follows the plan of making standards executable.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-12 from the repository interface and the project**:

**First, prior authorisation support is the standard form of the approve-before-treat workflow.** The primary repository description reads that it is an implementation guide using the standard to support the exchange of information between provider and payer, though that description arrives truncated from the interface, which this entry records rather than completing. **Prior authorisation is one of the most administratively costly steps in health insurance, and once the fields to be exchanged are written into an implementation guide they can be implemented in systems and also evaluated, so anyone working on health insurance process automation or claims should read guides of this kind before reading vendor documentation.**

**Second, the other guides in the family cover the outward-facing data on both the underwriting and claims sides.** The family includes a payer data exchange guide at nine stars and roughly eight hundred ninety megabytes, a plan network registry at six stars covering providers, organisations, and locations, a drug formulary guide at four stars, and a patient cost transparency guide at two stars. **These four answer what the payer holds, who is in its network, which drugs are covered, and what the patient pays, which are exactly the information surfaces where insurers and providers disagree most.**

**Third, rules and quality measurement are brought into the same family.** The family includes documentation templates and rules at eight stars under a permissive licence, and a quality measure data exchange guide, also at eight stars. **Making standards executable is therefore not only about exchanging data but also about exchanging rules and measures, which in insurance correspond to underwriting rules and quality indicators.**

**Fourth, two limits must be recorded together: the window and readability.** The family last received a push on the twenty-eighth of August, with the others between early July and late August, so the whole family sits outside the thaw window, and this entry therefore states the named gap it fills, namely the payer-side interoperability guide family for health insurance, which the site had not covered and which is the most complete public standard family on the payer side. **The primary repository description is a single line of seventy-seven bytes, and its guide site returned two hundred with only seven hundred ninety-five bytes, so the substance lives in generated content and versioned pages rather than in the repository summary, which is why the value of this entry is letting a reader know the family exists and what each part governs.**

**Fifth, the same organisation core repositories are active inside the window, for contrast.** The core specification repository at seven hundred forty-five stars and the quality measure, national directory, consent management, and data access policy repositories were all pushed in September, giving fifteen of fifteen organisation repositories inside the window. **A standards body being active and one branch of it having gone quiet can both be true, so the activity of a standards ecosystem has to be judged per subfamily rather than per organisation.**

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a property insurance data standard entry point, the beneficiary data of a national health programme on the same exchange standard, and legacy medical claims messaging, **while this entry supplies the payer-to-provider exchange specification family, which addresses the same business surface as the messaging entry but belongs to a different technical generation. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: separate the approval exchange from the payment exchange; remember that network and formulary directories are part of outward-facing data; treat rules and measures as standardisable too; judge an organisation activity per subfamily; and remember that a short description does not mean a small project.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, nothing was built and no guide was validated**, no validator was run against any example and no version page was opened, **so no claim is made about correctness or usability**. **Second, only repository metadata, search descriptions, and the primary repository description were read**, not the guide texts or generated artefacts. **Third, the version status of each guide and its applicable jurisdictions were not verified**, the naming suggesting a mainly American scope. **Fourth, why the primary repository language field reads as a shader language was not verified**, and this entry records the anomaly without inferring anything about the content. **Fifth, its licence status was not verified. Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-12 and states plainly that the family is interoperability standard material rather than an underwriting decision or a compliance opinion.**
